evidence_quotes.agenda: Never asked — call moves straight into confirming online-inquiry details.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A applied — no discovery-stage concern was raised; the piano-liability conversation was a policy exchange, not a worry the rep brushed off.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: The estimate-variability framing landed ('this estimate is purely an estimate based on the factors involved... you will only be billed for actual hours rendered'), but no rate-commit line, no explicit pay-less-if-faster line, no self-prep tip.

top_strength: Handled an awkward moment — telling the customer his upright piano can't be moved between floors for liability reasons — honestly and diplomatically without losing the booking.
coaching_note: The agenda question never got asked, so there was nothing to anchor discovery around — worth building the habit of opening with it before diving into address/inventory confirmation, even on inbound-inquiry follow-ups.
